tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zab chos rig 'dzin thugs thig las: rtsa gsum skong gso kun bzang mchod sprin bzhugs so:1$0000300 ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rtsa gsum lha la phyag 'tshal lo:

zab chos rig 'dzin thugs thig 'di: sgrub cing nyams len gang zag gis: nyams chag sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i phyir: skong bshags 'di la brtson par bya: sa ma ya: de yang gnas gtsang yid 'ong sar: rtsa gsum sku rten bshams pa'i drung: sgrub rdzas gtor ma sman raka dang: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang: rten sgrub skong mchod rdzas ma lus: bag dro lhun chags bshams nas su: khrus byas bde ba'i stan la 'dug: bdag bskyed la sogs gzhung bzhin bya: de nas gnas dang mchod rdzas la: bsang chu 'thor zhing 'di skad brjod: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ: ma dag snod bcud thams cad stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las padma 'od kyi zhing: 'ja' tshon 'od lnga dwangs mar 'khrigs pa'i dbus: mdzes shing yid 'ong pho brang chen por gyur: bhrūm̐ padma rā sya maṇḍa la bhrūm̐: oṃ brjod bral khyab brdal chos kyi dbyings: āḥrab 'byams dbyings mnyam ka pā lar: hūm̐ 'dod yon zag med mchod pa'i sprin: hoḥlha tshogs dgyes skong nus ldan gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: zhes pas gnas rdzas byin brlabs la: mdun du rigs 'dus lha tshogs bskyed: gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis spyan 'dren pa: hūm̐ hrī: chos dbyings dag pa'i gzhal yas nas: rtsa brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol: ma 'gag rang gsal klong yangs nas: yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: rtsa gsum bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas: thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī dharma pā la de ba ga ṇa sarba e hye hi badzra sa mā dza: padma sūrya tsand+ra st+waṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa dbyer med bsre: mchod bstod bzlas pa'i sgrub pa gzung: de nas thugs dam skong ba ni: hrī: mtha' bral chos dbyings brdal ba'i khyon gang ba'i: rab 'byams rgyal ba dgyes byed rmad byung rdzas: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab bshos: snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs rgyal srid sna bdun dang:

phun tshogs rtags rdzas brgyad dang 'dod yon lnga: gling bzhi ri rab bcas pa'i maṇḍal sogs: mi zad lha mi'i longs spyod sna tshogs kyis: nam mkha' rab 'byams gang ba'i thugs dam bskang: dbang po lnga dang tshil chen til mar me: khrag mkhris dri chu ma hā māṃ sa dang: cang te'u rkang gling rol mo'i sgra chen sgrog: sha sna snying sna rus chen zhing lpags sogs: dug lnga rang dag ye shes rdzas mchog 'dis: bde chen dwangs ma'i klong du thugs dam bskang: rnam bkra rig pa'i me tog snying rje'i gsur: 'od gsal mar me zab don byug pa dang: ting 'dzin zas mchog grags stong snyan pa'i sgra: ma 'gag rang byung rang shar mchod sprin gyis: skye med rig pa'i rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: spang blang dag pa rab 'byams thugs dam bskang: rtsa brgyad lo 'dab stong sbyar a mṛ ta: 'khor ba rgyun gcod dmar gsal khrag mtsho bskyil: snang srid dpal gyi dam rdzas gtor ma dang: rang byung lhun grub sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: thabs shes dwangs ma byang sems dza gad dang: yid 'phrog 'jo sgeg ldan pa'i mu dra yis: rang snang rigs 'dus lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: longs spyod mi zad ga ṇa'i rdzas chen po: bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag sna tshogs dang: dar 'phan rgyal mtshan phye phur bla bre dang: lda ldi yol ba dar dpyang cod pan gyis: dag pa rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams: rang shar rang grol chen po'i klong du bskang: gzhan yang sgrub rten skong dang mchod rdzas rnams: dngos 'byor mi zad 'dod yon rgya mtsho dang: yid sprul nam mkha' rab 'byams khyon bkang ste: ma lus 'dus pa'i gtso mchog dgyes skong phyir: ma tshang med pa'i dam rdzas 'di dag gis: khyab brdal chos dbyings klong du thugs dam bskang: hūm̐ hrī: chos dbyings bde chen dwangs ma 'ja' gur klong: bde gshegs kun 'dus rje btsun thod phreng rtsal: dgongs brda snyan brgyud rtsa ba brgyud bcas kyi:

dus gsum bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: ma 'gag rang shar lhun grub tshom bu'i klong: rigs 'dus dpal chen khro rgyal he ru ka: phyi nang zhi khro rgyud drug theg pa dgu'i: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: phrin las sna tshogs sgyu ma'i skur ston pa: dbyings kyi yum chen dpal ldan ḍā ki ma: rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ging lang ma sring dang: 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang: phyogs mtshams steng 'og rab 'jigs me phung klong: bstan srung dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud dang: pho nya las byed bka' nyan bcas pa yi: bstan srung dbang po rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: gzhan yang dkon mchog sri zhu yon tan mgron: rigs drug lan chags snying rje'i mgron la sogs: ma tshang med pa'i 'dod yon longs spyod kyis: bskang ngo gsol lo thugs dam gnyan po bskang: de ltar thugs dam bskang zhing mchod pa'i mthus: nyams chag sdig sgrib ma lus byang ba dang: phrin las rnam bzhi 'bad med lhun grub cing: srid pa'i 'gro kun bde chen klong du sgrol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: de ltar bskangs la yi ge brgya pa bzla'o: bdag 'dra lo tsā bai ro tsa na yis: thugs thig cha lag rtsa gsum skong ba 'di: o rgyan bka' bzhin yi ger btab ste sbas: las can dang 'phrad 'gro ba'i dpal du shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes brag dmar g.ya' ma lung nas spyan drangs pa'o// //
